description: Commodity intelligence for AI compute inputs — rare earths, industrial metals, and energy commodities that feed into chip manufacturing and data center construction. Covers neodymium/dysprosium (magnets), gallium/germanium (semiconductors), copper (interconnects/power), cobalt (batteries), natural gas (fab energy), and silicon wafer inputs. Returns spot pricing trends, supply concentration risk by country, 30/60/90d outlook, and active alerts. Use when assessing cost risk in long-term supply agreements or evaluating supplier ESG exposure. 6h cache.
name: compute.commodity
